home.heroSubtitle: Trust us with your keys, and we take care of the rest.
home.aboutText1: A village resident and passionate about our beautiful resort, I founded Serenity Pro Appart to offer owners absolute peace of mind.
home.aboutText2: My presence on site 365 days a year allows me to act quickly and personally oversee every detail. I'm not just a service provider - I'm your eyes and ears in Valfréjus.
home.aboutTitle: A local presence all year round
home.ctaTitle: Ready to entrust us with your keys?
home.ctaSubtitle: Contact us today for a personalized estimate for managing your property in Valfréjus.

cles.heroSubtitle: Offer your guests an exceptional welcome experience. Our key management service ensures a completely smooth arrival and departure.
cles.card1Desc: Personalized in-person welcome for your guests. Key handover in person and safety instructions for a worry-free arrival experience.
cles.card2Desc: Thorough inspection of the property condition before and after each stay to ensure your peace of mind.
cles.commSectionDesc: We are the dedicated point of contact for your guests throughout their stay. Assistance in French, English, and Italian.
cles.feature3Desc: Available for any question or issue.
cles.feature4Desc: Fast intervention thanks to our presence in Valfréjus.

location.heroSubtitle: Discover our selection of tailor-made services and quality equipment to enhance your alpine stay.
location.section1Subtitle: The softness of immaculate linen for absolute rest.
location.drapsDesc: Complete hotel-quality bedding sets. Fresh, breathable percale cotton, suited to the temperature of our mountains.
location.serviettesDesc: Luxurious bathroom set including bath towel, hand towel, and bath mat. Thickness and softness guaranteed.
location.section2Subtitle: Attention to detail from the moment you arrive.
location.alimentaireDesc: Discover the flavors of Valfréjus. With our welcome kit, it can be composed by yourself at Les Délices Alpins.
location.hygieneDesc: Maintenance kit including sponge, dish soap, dishwasher tablets, and trash bags.

menage.heroSubtitle: A careful service to prepare your apartment between two stays. Full cleaning, airing out, checking essential points, and tidying up before the next guests arrive.
menage.sectionSubtitle: An overview of our checklist, designed to keep your property clean, welcoming, and ready to use.
menage.card1Desc: Ventilation of all rooms, cleaning of frequently touched surfaces, disinfection of contact points with suitable products.
menage.card2Desc: Cleaning of worktops, degreasing of surfaces, appliance maintenance, and dishware check.
menage.card3Desc: Descaling, cleaning of sanitary fixtures, joints, and shower walls for a clean and pleasant space.
menage.card4Desc: General inspection of the apartment, putting away the last items, and securing the property before the next arrival.

travaux.heroTitle: Major Works / Renovation and Quick Repairs
travaux.card1Desc: At Serenity Pro Appart, we can put you in touch with the best tradespeople in the region.
travaux.card1Feature3: Handover of work in your absence.
travaux.card2Desc: On-demand intervention for small issues — from replacing a light fixture to adjusting a door.
travaux.expertiseSubtitle: Peace of mind guaranteed by our professionals.
travaux.expertiseSectionDesc: A thorough check before, during, or after your guests' stay to ensure that all systems in your property are working perfectly.
travaux.feature2Desc: Checks for leaks, water pressure, and water heater.
travaux.feature3Desc: Testing circuit breakers, lighting, and household appliances.
travaux.feature4Desc: Internet network diagnostics and connected equipment.
travaux.micro1Desc: Full availability for critical technical maintenance.
travaux.micro2Desc: Coordination with certified local tradespeople for complex renovations.

tarifs.heroSubtitle: Simple and practical services to prepare your apartment in Valfréjus, including cleaning, key handover, and linen rental.
tarifs.card1Desc: A complete and careful cleaning to make your apartment clean and ready to welcome your guests.
tarifs.card2Desc: A simple and organized key handover to facilitate your guests' arrival and departure, and the property inspection at check-out.
tarifs.card3Desc: Ready-to-use sheet and towel kits to easily equip your apartment.
tarifs.ctaSubtitle: Each apartment has its own needs. Contact us to define a service adapted to your property and your guests.

contact.heroSubtitle: A question about our property management services or need personalized assistance during your stay? We are entirely at your disposal.
contact.formSuccess: Message sent successfully! We will reply shortly.
